name: Restaurant (Full Service)
description: A full-service dining restaurant featuring a dedicated commercial kitchen and table service. The menu is meal-centric and structured around a multi-course progression—from starters and entrées through to desserts, with beverage offerings designed to accompany food.

sections.name: Appetizers & Starters
sections.description: Opening courses designed to awaken the palate before the main course. Features hot and chilled soups, vibrant seasonal salads, artisanal small plates, and communal sharing platters with house-made dips.

subSections.name: Soups
subSections.description: Warm broths, bisques, velvety purées, and seasonal chilled soups served with freshly baked bread.

subSections.name: Salads
subSections.description: Fresh leafy greens, grain salads, and composed raw or roasted vegetable starters with signature house dressings.

subSections.name: Small Plates
subSections.description: Individual savory starter portions, culinary small bites, and hot or cold finger appetizers.

subSections.name: Sharing Platters & Dips
subSections.description: Generous charcuterie assortments, artisanal cheese boards, warm flatbread dips, and communal tasting boards for the table.

sections.name: Main Courses / Entrées
sections.description: The primary course and focal point of dining, presenting chef-curated culinary creations. Encompasses roasted poultry, braised and pan-seared meats, delicate seafood, and hearty plant-based entrées.

subSections.name: Meat & Poultry
subSections.description: Oven-roasted chicken, tender braised meats, duck breast, lamb chops, and savory poultry masterworks.

subSections.name: Seafood
subSections.description: Pan-seared fillets, poached ocean catches, seafood casseroles, and sustainably caught daily fish.

subSections.name: Vegetarian & Vegan Mains
subSections.description: Nutrient-dense, vegetable-forward entrées crafted with roasted grains, pulses, and gourmet plant proteins.

sections.name: Pasta & Rice Dishes
sections.description: Hearty carbohydrate-centric entrées showcasing traditional Italian pastas, arborio risottos, aromatic biryanis, and specialty wok-tossed noodles.

subSections.name: Pasta
subSections.description: Artisan freshly extruded and rolled pastas paired with slow-simmered sauces, pestos, and emulsified reductions.

subSections.name: Rice Dishes
subSections.description: Velvety slow-stirred risottos, fragrant spiced biryanis, paellas, and heritage grain bowls.

subSections.name: Noodles
subSections.description: Stir-fried ribbon noodles, egg noodles, and savory noodle bowls tossed with fresh greens and savory seasonings.

sections.name: Grills & Specialties
sections.description: High-heat chargrilled cuts, prime dry-aged steaks, fire-kissed seafood, low-and-slow smokehouse meats, and premier signature house specialties that require meat cooking temperature selection and custom weight portions.

subSections.name: Premium Steaks & Cuts
subSections.description: Grain-fed and grass-fed ribeyes, tenderloin filets, strip loins, and bone-in prime cuts seared to precision.

subSections.name: Grilled Seafood
subSections.description: Whole grilled branzino, lobster tails, king prawns, and flame-broiled seafood skewers.

subSections.name: BBQ & Smokehouse
subSections.description: Slow-smoked beef ribs, pulled pork, smoked brisket, and wood-fired barbecue platters.

subSections.name: House Specialties
subSections.description: Executive chef signature showpieces, proprietary roasted specialties, and signature heritage dishes.

sections.name: Sandwiches & Burgers
sections.description: Gourmet handheld selections featuring freshly ground artisan beef and chicken patties, slow-roasted deli meats, pressed paninis, and club sandwiches prepared on bakery-fresh breads with customizable buns, cheeses, and accompaniments.

subSections.name: Gourmet Burgers
subSections.description: Single and double prime patties, crispy chicken burgers, and gourmet plant-based patties served on toasted specialty buns.

subSections.name: Sandwiches
subSections.description: Warm crusty paninis, toasted triple-layer clubs, open-faced tartines, and deli meat specialty sandwiches.

sections.name: Sides & Extras
sections.description: Essential accompaniments, side dishes, warm breads, seasoned vegetables, and extra dipping sauces that round out dinner entrées and accommodate table sharing.

subSections.name: Hot Sides
subSections.description: Crispy fries, potato purée, gratins, roasted seasonal tubers, and warm buttered vegetables.

subSections.name: Cold Sides
subSections.description: House slaws, marinated olives, pickled market vegetables, and refreshing side salads.

subSections.name: Sauces & Dips
subSections.description: Extra ramekins of handcrafted sauces, aiolis, flavored pestos, and warm pan gravies.

subSections.name: Bread Basket
subSections.description: Warm artisan dinner rolls, garlic baguettes, rosemary focaccia, and seeded sourdough with churned salted butter.

sections.name: Kids' Menu
sections.description: Child-friendly, balanced meals in smaller portions created specifically for younger guests aged 12 and under. Prepared with approachable flavors, mild seasonings, and wholesome side options.

subSections.name: Kids' Mains
subSections.description: Crispy chicken tenders, mini cheeseburger sliders, mild buttered pasta, and battered fish goujons.

subSections.name: Kids' Sides
subSections.description: Kid-sized portions of skin-on fries, sweet potato fries, fresh fruit skewers, and steamed sweet corn.

subSections.name: Kids' Drinks
subSections.description: Fresh apple juice, pure orange juice, cold whole milk, and babyccinos served in child-safe cups.

subSections.name: Kids' Desserts
subSections.description: Single-scoop ice creams with sprinkles, warm mini chocolate brownies, and seasonal fruit cups.

sections.name: Desserts
sections.description: The concluding sweet course of the meal. Features warm baked puddings, chilled parfaits, multi-layered patisserie cakes, and churned artisanal gelatos crafted to leave a lasting impression.

subSections.name: Hot Desserts
subSections.description: Molten chocolate lava cakes, seasonal fruit crumbles, baked soufflés, and warm sticky toffee puddings.

subSections.name: Cold Desserts
subSections.description: Silky panna cotta, classic Italian tiramisu, layered chocolate mousses, and set cheesecakes.

subSections.name: Cakes & Pastries
subSections.description: Gourmet gateaux, individual tartlets, mille-feuille slices, and pastry chef showcase specials.

subSections.name: Ice Cream & Sorbet
subSections.description: House-churned dairy gelatos, fruit sorbets, and composed sundae bowls.

sections.name: Hot Beverages
sections.description: End-of-meal digestif hot beverages and comforting table drinks, highlighting freshly extracted espresso specialties and premium loose-leaf whole teas.

subSections.name: Coffee
subSections.description: Double espresso, Americano, flat white, cappuccino, latte, and specialty filter extractions.

subSections.name: Tea
subSections.description: Full-leaf black, green, jasmine, Earl Grey teas, and caffeine-free botanical infusions.

sections.name: Cold Beverages & Soft Drinks
sections.description: Non-alcoholic cold beverages, refreshing dining accompaniments, table mineral waters, chilled cold-pressed juices, and handcrafted zero-proof culinary mocktails.

subSections.name: Fresh Juices
subSections.description: Cold-pressed citrus, green detox cleanses, and freshly squeezed seasonal fruit blends.

subSections.name: Soft Drinks
subSections.description: Premium glass-bottled sodas, tonic waters, artisanal ginger beers, and iced teas.

subSections.name: Water
subSections.description: Bottled still mineral water, natural effervescent sparkling waters, and fresh infused water carafes.

subSections.name: Mocktails
subSections.description: Complex zero-proof botanical drinks, muddled herb sodas, and tropical fruit coolers.

sections.name: Breakfast
sections.description: Morning breakfast service menu available for restaurants operating early morning meal hours. Features freshly prepared hot eggs, griddle pancakes, and lighter continental breakfast plates.

subSections.name: Egg Dishes
subSections.description: Customizable eggs Benedict, three-egg country omelets, Mediterranean shakshuka, and scrambled plates.

subSections.name: Pancakes & Waffles
subSections.description: Stacked buttermilk pancakes, golden malted Belgian waffles, and thick-cut brioche French toast.

subSections.name: Light Breakfast
subSections.description: Greek yogurt fruit parfaits, steel-cut oatmeal, avocado sourdough toast, and fruit bowls.

timeBehavior.note: Available during morning breakfast service only (07:00–11:00).

sections.name: Set Menus & Combos
sections.description: Prix fixe culinary journeys, express midday business lunch bundles, and family sharing feasts offering curated sequential courses and great dining value.

subSections.name: Lunch Combos
subSections.description: Speedy two-course express midday combinations designed for efficient lunch dining.

subSections.name: Family Platters
subSections.description: Generous banqueting spreads for 3 to 6 guests including shared proteins, sides, and accompaniments.

subSections.name: Prix Fixe / Set Menus
subSections.description: Three-course and five-course chef tasting journeys with structured starter, main, and dessert course pairings.

sections.name: Seasonal & Chef's Specials
sections.description: Regularly rotating seasonal dishes and executive chef market inspirations celebrating limited-run micro-seasonal produce, prized game, and fresh catch arrivals.

subSections.name: Seasonal Offerings
subSections.description: Dishes highlighting peak-season harvest ingredients such as white asparagus, heirloom varieties, or autumn mushrooms.

subSections.name: Chef's Tasting Specials
subSections.description: Weekend experimental culinary creations, dry-aged cut features, and whole-catch seafood preparations.

systemFeatures.name: Spice Level Customization
systemFeatures.description: Allows guests to specify spice heat intensity from mild to extra hot on adaptable curries, pastas, and savory dishes.

systemFeatures.name: Meat Doneness Selection
systemFeatures.description: Enables temperature preferences (Rare, Medium Rare, Medium, Medium Well, Well Done) for steaks, burgers, and flame-grilled cuts.

systemFeatures.name: Allergen & Dietary Badging
systemFeatures.description: Displays clear allergen alerts and dietary tags (Gluten-Free, Dairy-Free, Nut-Free, Halal, Vegan) across all meal courses for guest safety.

systemFeatures.name: Real-Time Inventory Badges
systemFeatures.description: Shows real-time item availability statuses such as 'In Stock', 'Sold Out Today', or 'Limited Portions' to prevent orders for unavailable dishes.

systemFeatures.name: Kids' Menu & Portions
systemFeatures.description: Provides dedicated child-friendly menu sections with balanced smaller portion sizing and bundled beverage or side selections.

systemFeatures.name: Set Menus & Course Bundles
systemFeatures.description: Supports multi-course prix fixe selections, express lunch combos, and family-style sharing platters with required course choices.

systemFeatures.name: Meal Time Restrictions
systemFeatures.description: Enforces operational service windows for breakfast, lunch specials, and dinner courses based on kitchen schedules.
